events.name: GXY BOOST
events.summary: Part of the BOOST group of events Monday and Friday at the same time.
events.description:
Part of the BOOST group of events Monday and Friday at the same time.

A group ride which focuses on intervals or power pyramids and staying in the draft is essential for this event

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category	- B
Power      	- 3.0 > 4.0 wkg but expect the event to finish with an average power around 3.5wkg based on a 	75kg rider

Fence	- Enabled to KICK when in use, used at the leader's discretion	
Draft	- Enabled – focus required to stay within the group

Sweeper	- No

ETHOS

events.name: GXY SURGE
events.summary: Part of the SURGE group of events, Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday at the same time.
events.description:
EVENT DESCRIPTION

Part of the SURGE group of events, Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday at the same time.  

This event brings a different workout structure each of the four days of the week.  This may include power pyramids, intervals and chase strategies.  Expect a fun social event where sprints and Kom segments may be included.

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category    - D

Power 	    - 1.6 > 2.5wkg but expect the event to finish around 2.1wkg based on a 75kg rider.

Fence 	    - Will be set to KICK! used at the leader's discretion

Draft	    - Enabled – focus required to stay within the group

Sweeper     - Yes! Red beacon and beacon support riders will have a GXY tag after their name

events.name: GXY 75 ENDURANCE
events.summary: Part of the GXY ENDURANCE weekend group of rides
events.description:
Part of the GXY ENDURANCE weekend group of rides

This endurance event on a week by week basis will either be for 75 mins, 75kms or course specific.  

Both Category C and Category D riders for this event will launch at the same time on the same course.  A gap will be created by the Category C group but the social chat will continue between both groups throughout the endurance ride.

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category	- C and D

Power 		- C 2.3 > 2.7wkg but expect the event to finish around 2.5wkg based on a 75kg rider
		          D 1.8 > 2.2wkg but expect the event to finish around 2.0wkg based on a 75kg rider

Fence 		- Will be set to KICK! used at the leader's discretion

Draft		- Enabled – focus required to stay within the group

Sweeper 	- Yes! Red beacon and beacon support riders will have a GXY tag after their name
